meta.revisionPolicy: Revised continuously; finalised over ~3 years. Vintages are kept.
meta.coverage: The NSO back series, GVA by the 19 sub-industries, 1950-51 to 2011-12: levels, real growth and share of nominal GVA
meta.note: The back series adds a nineteenth sub-industry, transport by other means, that the current series folds into the others.
